description: Live guild battle rooms; service delegates spendable guild GP, ranking counters and final settlement to the SQL repository before publishing room state to Valkey.

lock_sequence.note: Serialize room round identities and terminal settlement before reward writes.
Lock all affected guilds, including draws, before standing creation can acquire a guild foreign-key lock; award GP through GuildRepository.AddPoints using the ambient claim transaction.
Lock affected standings before cumulative reward GP, win/loss/draw and medal mutations.
Claim per-join exit (room_id, character_id, join_id) before applying departure settlement.

lock_sequence.table: characters / inventory_items / equipment_slots / character_depots / depot_items / tavern_character_status
lock_sequence.note: Battle settlement reuses the ambient RunInTx transaction (tier 2 character -> tier 3 inventory/equipment -> conditional tier 5 depot); postExitHook (ResetFullness and ClaimDelivery, locking tier 2 character before tier 8 tavern_character_status) and MarkExitDeliveryDone commit in the same RunInTx transaction before LeaveRoom Valkey cleanup.
